description: POST /v1/businesses/{id}/attest request body. The server stamps verified_at, computes valid_until, applies both signatures, and appends to the log — clients never supply those.

attestation_id.description: Ignored when present; the server always generates fla_<ulid> (audit H-10).

authorization_id.description: Opaque one-time authorization id resolved from FactLock's server-side store.

business_key_id.description: Custodial business key_id to sign with (spec §3: v1 custodial).

device_time.description: Client-observed time; metadata ONLY. verified_at always comes from the server clock.

factlock_key_id.description: Optional; defaults to the current active FactLock key.

title: Attestation issuance request v1
